bodyHtml:
Every football fan knows that two items are the true symbols of support for your favorite team.

Your sides kit, and a scarf.

Now available at spindlesunited.store, The Spindles Scarf is the first addition to the 2024 Spindles Collection.

A football scarf is the symbol of any club: the colors, the crest, the wording.

In the winter you wear it around your neck with style. In the summer you hold it high above your head in support.

The Spindles Scarf embodies everything a football scarf should be.

We know it looks like a Christmas scarf. It doesn't help that we are releasing it during the holiday season.

But the bright red, smooth green, and crisp white is Spindles. We can't help it!

We are proud of our colors, and are excited to share them with the help of United Kingdom brand, Global Scarves.

The Spindles Scarf was announced earlier this week.

Shot in downtown Cohoes, a couple of the players sported the new scarf for its official announcement video.

Not only is the scarf a symbol of the club, but it is also a sign of exciting things to come in 2024.

Get your own at spindlesunited.store.
